title: Create Lead Generation ads
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Lead Generation ads. # Introduction Lead Generation is an ad objective through which advertisers can drive sales and generate leads on TikTok. You can create Lead Generation ads to encourage prospects to fill out a form and provide their information, where personal information is pre-filled (for example, Email and Name), to signal their interest in your products or services. **You can use Campaign Management API to create Lead Generation ads, and this helps streamline your ad creation experience, and elevate operational efficiency and scalability.** # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713609895937&rid=7llhcla7zmh) for details. - To create Lead Generation Ads, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946&rid=7llhcla7zmh) to find out how to configure permissions. - If you want to create a Lead Generation ad with an Instant Form, an Instant Form is necessary. # Use Cases - To learn about how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as **Instant Form**, refer to [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482920012801). - To learn about how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as **Website**, refer to [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482976097281). - To learn about how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as **TikTok direct messages**, refer to [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482992153601). - To learn about how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as **instant messaging apps**, refer to [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482999036930). - To learn about how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as **phone call**, refer to [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482936048641). - To learn about how to obtain leads from lead generation ads, see [Obtain leads as advertisers](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1806817494948930). > **Note**
> To protect customer information, only ad account admins can create and query lead download tasks or download the leads. Ad account roles are configured in the Business Center. # Related docs - [Campaign Management API](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381823123458&rid=24jiu7kp2km) - [Campaign Management Guide](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713781404673&rid=24jiu7kp2km) - [Lead Generation Guide](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/build-instant-form?lang=en) on TikTok Business Help Center # API reference The endpoints for lead generation ads can be divided into several categories: **Testing leads** * [Create test leads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739047132614722) * [Get test leads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739048460493826) * [Delete test lead](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739049313198081) **Downloading leads** * [Create a lead download task](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739052936772610) * [Download leads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739053563877378) **Subscribing to leads** * [Subscribe to leads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739092028876801) * [Get subscriptions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739093832125442) * [Cancel a subscription](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739094758789122)
